notes.title: Pet the Cats!
notes.content:
A brand-new, highly asked-for feature has been added to Lake — you can now pet the cats that are lounging around Mildred’s home! Just like in real life, each cat is different and has their own unique response, so it’s up to you to determine how to earn their trust so you can give them all the pets… and maybe even that ever-elusive belly rub.

[previewyoutube=vHfQ6KDV1iA;full][/previewyoutube]
Meredith can pet the cats in Lake Classic as well as Classic Endless Mode. Cats don’t really like the snow, you see. Who can blame them? Maybe Thomas... ;)

notes.title: Now Available: Endless Mode!
notes.content:
The people have spoken and they have spoken clearly! We weren't indifferent to the many requests for an endless mode, and were delighted to eventually put it on our to-do list as the next task to work on.

So, here it finally is: Endless mode!

If you can't get enough of driving around your favorite little laketown, get ready to deliver mail ad infinitum!

And just to manage your expectations: there will be no stories or new dialogues, or any other mail carrier comedy-drama. Just a never-ending cycle of playable days with randomized delivery lists to fulfil at your own convenience.

Endless mode is available for both Lake Classic and Season's Greetings environments. So start up Lake, hop in the mail truck, turn on the radio, and get cranking. Neither snow nor rain... as Frank Coleman would say: the mail doesn't deliver itself!

notes.title: Season's Greetings Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing!

This small hotfix contains several smaller bugfixes and some audio changes to hopefully narrow down the reported issues.

We are working hard to solve any remaining issues.

It would help us a lot if you could provide us with some more info. If possible, please share at least some of the following info when encountering issues:
[list]
[*]Player logs. These can be found at [code]C:\Users\< your username here > \AppData\LocalLow\Gamious\Lake\Player.log[/code] You can also use Windows Key + R and enter [code] %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Gamious\Lake\ [/code] Easiest way to share is via either [url=https://pastebin.com/] pastebin [/url], [url=https://filebin.net/] filebin [/url] or a similar website. Alternatively you can upload the file somewhere and provide us with a link to download. Third option is to email us via info@gamious.com

[*]DxDiag info (especially the Audio section). You can get this info by using Windows Key + R and enter "DxDiag" in the box that appears. We're most interested in the audio tab(s). You can export all information as a text file or send us screenshots. Any additional info you can provide about your audio setup would also help.

[*]Do you have any other (relevant) software running at the same time? Any info you can think of would help us narrow down and reproduce the issue.
[/list]

Again, thank you all for playing and reporting issues!

notes.title: Season's Greetings is out now!
notes.content:
Christmas came early this year! Grab a nice cup of cocoa and your favorite blanket, and jump right into the winter wonderland of Providence Oaks today!

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450860/Lake__Seasons_Greetings/]Season’s Greetings[/url], a prequel DLC to Lake, you’ll be transported back to beautiful Providence Oaks during the snowy waning days of 1985. Step into the shoes of Thomas Weiss, almost-retired postal worker and father to Lake’s protagonist Meredith. Delivering the mail is only half the story, as Thomas meets and helps out both old friends and new arrivals. How happy will their holidays be? Can everyone in Providence Oaks end 1985 with a bang? Once again, it’s up to you.

To celebrate the launch of Season's Greetings, Lake will have a 60% discount (starting Wednesday, November 15 at 10 AM PST, ending Tuesday, November 21 at 10 AM PST).

[previewyoutube=79pQq1cWRGc;full][/previewyoutube]
PS: This might get snowed under a bit (badum-tish!), but we have added Steam Cloud Saves to Lake. This allows you to synchronize your saves to another device.

The option should be enabled by default, and can be manually disabled via Properties > General. If you do not have this option, please check that cloud saving is enabled via Steam Settings.
If you have any issues please post them in the Bugs section on the Lake Steam discussion board.

notes.title: Lake DLC 'Season's Greetings' coming this holiday season!
notes.content:
We're super happy to announce '[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450860]Season's Greetings[/url]', in which we return to our cozy little laketown Providence Oaks! 

[previewyoutube=5ivtaysFPfY;full][/previewyoutube]
You might wonder how Lake's story could continue with all the different endings it offered. Well, we were wondering the same, and that's why Season's Greetings is not a sequel, but a prequel! 

It's December 23, 1985, eight months before Meredith returns to Providence Oaks. You take on the role of her father, Thomas, and will be delivering the mail like he's been doing for years. We don't want to spoil too much, but what we can say is:
[list]
[*] It's the final days of the year, so expect Holiday Season happenings!
[*] P.O. will be covered in a blanket of snow, and cheered up with lots of Christmas lighting.
[*] Meet new characters, but you'll of course also see lots of familiar faces.
[*] Nancy will be complaining.
[*] Frank might be betting on sports.
[*] Mildred could need your help.
[*] Maureen will definitely yell to the kitchen.
[*] And Jack's playlist will also have Christmas tunes! But it might still be a bit short. ;)
[/list]
We hope you share our excitement, and make sure to check back here for updates. We will share more details about the game in the coming months, so stay tuned and wishlist Season's Greetings [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450860]here![/url]

notes.title: [Update 1.0.10.1] Stuck in transit
notes.content:
This is a small patch that includes a few minor changes. After this update we will nog longer support Windows 8, as Microsoft has also ended support for it on January 10, 2023

Changes:
[list]
[*] Credits update. Added missing entries and fixed scrolling issue.
[*] Crash in main menu fixed. This was an issue that happened on most Windows 8 and 8.1 devices. A few clever users have solved this on their own by removing or renaming the file. We have now implemented a fix for this so you no longer have to tinker with the files to get the game running.
[*] Windows 8 no longer supported. The game will still be playable on Windows 8, but we will no longer offer support for Windows 8 specific issues.
[*] Fixed a localisation issue where English text would be displayed when another language is selected.
[*] We're still looking for a solution to the pesky audio bug.
[/list]

As always, if you encounter any bugs or issues, please create a post in the Bugs/Known Issues section of the forums. For more info, please see this post.

Thank you for playing Lake!

notes.title: [Hotfix 1.0.3] Special delivery!

Thank you to everyone who has submitted bugs/feedback, and thank you all for playing!

[h1]Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Invert Y axis setting applied to photocamera controls.
[*] Update Input Plugin (Should fix several controller issues). TIP: Try turning on or off Steam Input -> Lake > Properties > Controller > Enable/Disable Steam Input. Also try turning on/off the controller support in Controller General Settings (Steam).
[*] Achievement [spoiler](final choice Robert)[/spoiler] fixed.
[*] Azerty detection fixed. Formerly it would detect a qwerty keyboard as azerty. This should now be fixed.

[/list] 

If you encounter any other issues, especially input related, please let us know!

Any info related to bugs and/or issues can be posted in the Bugs/Known Issues subforum and we will try our best to look into it.

notes.title: Deliver 80s post in 80s postal delivery story Lake, due out this year
notes.content:
Our VidBud Colm used to be a postman back in the old country, and from what he’s said it was a job he very much enjoyed. Small wonder, then, that big city slicker Meredith would want a go of it for a couple of weeks in Lake, an open world explore-a-town game due out by the end of the year (and a poor SEO optimisation if you ask me, since if I ever forget the name of it I’m going to have to Google things like “post delivery woman video game small town” to find it again).

You play as Meredith, delivering parcels and interacting with the locals of peaceful and beautiful Providence Oaks at a fairly sedate pace. Take a look at the trailer, which was highlighted at during today’s Guerrilla Collective not-E3 livestream, to see if it’s the kind of gentle, twiddling-guitar-music story you’d like – it is obviously the sort of gentle, twiddling-guitar-music story I’d like.

(more…)
